sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, how our minds can be influenced by the way options are presented to us
sentences.zh: 本周的《Hidden Brain》将探讨我们的思维如何受到选项呈现方式的影响，

sentences.en: and how we can make choices more wisely.
sentences.zh: 以及我们如何能做出更明智的选择。

sentences.en: As we move through life, we are constantly making choices.
sentences.zh: 在我们的一生中，我们不断地在做选择。

sentences.en: When we buy a car, choose a college, or pick a romantic partner,
sentences.zh: 当我们买车、选大学或挑选伴侣时，

sentences.en: we think about the ramifications of different options.
sentences.zh: 我们会考虑不同选项带来的后果。

sentences.en: One thing we usually don't consider,
sentences.zh: 但我们通常忽略了一点，

sentences.en: how the way in which choices are presented to us shapes what we decide to do.
sentences.zh: 那就是选项的呈现方式如何塑造了我们的决定。

sentences.en: At Columbia University, Eric Johnson studies how the presentation of choices can influence people
sentences.zh: 在哥伦比亚大学，埃里克·约翰逊研究选项的呈现方式如何影响人们，

sentences.en: and how these insights can be used for both good and evil.
sentences.zh: 以及这些见解如何被用于善恶两端。

sentences.en: Eric Johnson, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 埃里克·约翰逊，欢迎来到《Hidden Brain》。

sentences.en: Very glad to be with you, Shankar.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能和你交流，尚卡尔。

sentences.en: Some years ago, Eric, a graduate student came to you
sentences.zh: 埃里克，几年前，一位研究生来找你，

sentences.en: and said she could change the sofas that customers would buy
sentences.zh: 说她可以通过改变销售沙发的网站背景，

sentences.en: by changing the background on a website selling the sofas.
sentences.zh: 来改变顾客购买的沙发款式。

sentences.en: You were skeptical that this was the case,
sentences.zh: 你当时对此表示怀疑，

sentences.en: so she ran a lab experiment to convince you.
sentences.zh: 所以她做了一个实验室实验来让你信服。

sentences.en: Can you tell me what she did and what happened?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我她做了什么，结果如何吗？

sentences.en: What she suggested is that the background, what's called the wallpaper website, might influence people's choice.
sentences.zh: 她提出，背景，也就是所谓的网站壁纸，可能会影响人们的选择。

sentences.en: So she went out and designed several different website backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 于是她设计了几种不同的网站背景。

sentences.en: One, for example, would be clouds embedded on a blue sky.
sentences.zh: 例如，一种是蓝天上的云朵。

sentences.en: And she showed that when you ask people what they thought of when they saw that, they would say comfort.
sentences.zh: 她展示了当人们看到这个背景时，他们会联想到舒适。

sentences.en: Another one might be dollar bills embedded on a green page.
sentences.zh: 另一种可能是绿色页面上的美元钞票。

sentences.en: And she asked people what they thought of.
sentences.zh: 她问人们想到了什么。

sentences.en: Not surprisingly, they would say coSt.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，他们说的是成本。

sentences.en: She then gave people a task where they had to choose a couch.
sentences.zh: 然后她让人们完成一项选择沙发的任务。

sentences.en: One couch was expensive and comfortable.
sentences.zh: 其中一款沙发昂贵且舒适。

sentences.en: The other couch was actually cheap and uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 另一款沙发则便宜且不舒适。

sentences.en: And what she found is that people actually chose a couch that was more compatible with
sentences.zh: 结果她发现，人们确实选择了与

sentences.en: the background.
sentences.zh: 背景更契合的沙发。

sentences.en: That is, with the blue clouds, they would choose the comfortable but more expensive couch.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，在蓝色云朵背景下，他们会选择舒适但更昂贵的沙发。

sentences.en: With the green money, they chose a cheap, uncomfortable couch.
sentences.zh: 而在绿色钞票背景下，他们选择了便宜且不舒适的沙发。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You know, this reminds me of a similar situation, this one drawn from real life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这让我想起了一个类似的情况，来自现实生活。

sentences.en: The researcher Kareem Haggag looked at students at the U.S.
sentences.zh: 研究员卡里姆·哈加格观察了美国

sentences.en: Military Academy at West Point.
sentences.zh: 西点军校的学生。

sentences.en: They were taking introductory classes in economics, calculus, chemistry, and other subjects.
sentences.zh: 他们选修了经济学、微积分、化学等入门课程。

sentences.en: The students were assigned to these classes at various times of the day.
sentences.zh: 学生们被分配在一天中的不同时间上这些课。

sentences.en: Some took the class first thing in the morning.
sentences.zh: 有些人一早第一节课就上。

sentences.en: Others took the same class later in the day.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则在当天晚些时候上同样的课。

sentences.en: Kareem Haggag looked at how likely students were to later choose that subject as their college major.
sentences.zh: 卡里姆·哈加格研究了学生后来选择该学科作为大学专业的可能性。

sentences.en: Here's what he found.
sentences.zh: 以下是他的发现。

sentences.en: Students who are randomly assigned to the first period 7.30 a.m.
sentences.zh: 被随机分配到早上7点30分第一节课的

sentences.en: section are about 10% less likely to choose the corresponding major compared to a student who takes that class later in the day.
sentences.zh: 学生，选择相应专业的可能性比当天晚些时候上课的学生低约10%。

sentences.en: We also compare two students who are sitting in the exact same classroom, but one of whom just had a free period as a break before,
sentences.zh: 我们还比较了坐在同一间教室里的两名学生，其中一人之前刚休息过，

sentences.en: and the other came from one or more back-to-back classes.
sentences.zh: 而另一人则是从一节或多节连堂课中过来的。

sentences.en: We find that each additional back-to-back class reduces the likelihood that that student enrolls in the major by about 12%.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，每多上一节连堂课，该学生选择该专业的可能性就会降低约12%。

sentences.en: It's not quite fluffy clouds and sofas, but it's the same general principle.
sentences.zh: 这虽然不像云朵和沙发那样直观，但原理是一样的。

sentences.en: Something that should not influence a consequential decision, like which major you select in college,
sentences.zh: 本不该影响重大决策（比如大学选专业）的事情，

sentences.en: seems to be influenced by when the class was scheduled or if you took that class right after a challenging class.
sentences.zh: 似乎却受到了课程安排时间，或者你是否刚上完一门高难度课程的影响。

sentences.en: What's interesting about that example is notice the decision is actually quite a while after you've taken the class.
sentences.zh: 这个例子有趣的地方在于，请注意，决定是在你上完课很久之后才做出的。

sentences.en: You're not sitting there at 9 a.m.
sentences.zh: 你并不是坐在早上9点

sentences.en: in the calculus class making a decision.
sentences.zh: 的微积分课上做决定的。

sentences.en: Someday later, you're given a form, what do you want as a major?
sentences.zh: 几天后，你拿到一张表格，问你想选什么专业？

sentences.en: And the memory of how awful you felt during that calculus class or during that economics class
sentences.zh: 而你在那门微积分课或经济学课上感到多么糟糕的记忆，

sentences.en: actually is what's influencing your choice.
sentences.zh: 实际上正在影响你的选择。

sentences.en: So it's not only that immediate environment, like the webpages,
sentences.zh: 所以，不仅是即时环境（如网页）会产生影响，

sentences.en: but it's also the memories of that environment that make a difference.
sentences.zh: 对环境的记忆也会产生影响。

sentences.en: So one last idea along the same lines.
sentences.zh: 最后再分享一个类似的观点。

sentences.en: You've asked volunteers how much they care about global climate change and global warming
sentences.zh: 你曾询问志愿者他们有多关心全球气候变化和全球变暖，

sentences.en: and what they would be willing to do to fix it.
sentences.zh: 以及他们愿意为此做些什么。

sentences.en: But you've also measured something curious.
sentences.zh: 但你也测量了一些奇怪的东西。

sentences.zh: 你测量了他们回答问题时

sentences.en: as they're answering the question.
sentences.zh: 的环境温度。

sentences.en: Describe to me the setup of the study
sentences.zh: 请向我描述一下这项研究的设置

sentences.en: and what you found, Eric.
sentences.zh: 以及你的发现，埃里克。

sentences.zh: 我让人们访问我们的网站，

sentences.en: and one of the things we asked them about
sentences.zh: 我们询问他们的事情之一

sentences.zh: 就是他们的邮政编码。

sentences.en: And my co-authors cleverly figured out

sentences.en: they could actually figure out
sentences.zh: 他们实际上可以推算出

sentences.en: what the temperature that day was
sentences.zh: 他们回答问卷那天

sentences.zh: 的气温。

sentences.en: air.
sentences.zh: 空气。

sentences.zh: 就像网站颜色可能会改变选择一样，我们想知道环境温度

sentences.en: temperature would change how concerned they were with global warming, and in some studies actually
sentences.zh: 是否会改变他们对全球变暖的关注程度，在某些研究中，甚至

sentences.en: how much they would donate for a global warming charity.
sentences.zh: 改变他们为全球变暖慈善机构捐款的金额。

sentences.en: And surprisingly, we found that on days
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，我们发现，在比平均气温

sentences.en: that were warmer than average, people would give more money and be more concerned about global
sentences.zh: 更暖和的日子里，人们会捐更多的钱，也更关心全球

sentences.en: warming.
sentences.zh: 变暖。

sentences.en: Days that were colder than average, they were much less concerned about global warming,
sentences.zh: 而在比平均气温更冷的日子里，他们对全球变暖的关注度要低得多，

sentences.zh: 捐的钱也更少。

sentences.en: I understand that experiments have been run along the same lines
sentences.zh: 我了解到，有人做过类似的实验，

sentences.en: where you can actually manipulate the temperature,
sentences.zh: 你可以实际操纵温度，

sentences.en: you know, fiddle with the thermostat,
sentences.zh: 你知道，摆弄一下恒温器，

sentences.en: and you get similar results?
sentences.zh: 也能得到类似的结果？

sentences.en: Yeah, the research we've done that
sentences.zh: 是的，我们所做的研究

sentences.zh: 确实得出了非常相似的结果，

sentences.en: that warmer temperatures increase concern with global warming.
sentences.zh: 即温暖的气温会增加对全球变暖的关注。

sentences.zh: 我们最近做了一项名为“元分析”的研究，

sentences.zh: 埃里克，这里有趣的地方在于，
